name: Drawn Underline Field
tags: input floating-label underline svg focus draw text
note: The underline is an SVG path with pathLength=1 whose stroke-dashoffset animates 1 to 0, so the rule literally draws itself on focus while the label springs up.
html: Appears in the workspace sidebar

name: Counter Ring Field
tags: input counter maxlength ring progress error filled
note: An SVG circle with pathLength=100 turns the character count into a stroke-dashoffset arc, and the digit re-mounts its own keyframe on every change for a mechanical tick.
html: Looks good 0/60

name: Auto-Grow Composer
tags: textarea autogrow composer keyboard-shortcut send mirror
note: A hidden mirror div measures the wrapped text so the textarea height can be set in pixels and eased with a real height transition instead of snapping.
html: Empty

name: Morphing Search
tags: search expand icon filter escape live-region teal
note: One flex container animates its own width with a spring curve while the input fades and slides in on a delay, so the icon appears to unfold into a field.
html: 9 commands available

name: Strength Segments
tags: password strength meter reveal toggle segments rules
note: Four segment bars fill by scaleX with a per-segment transition-delay, so the meter sweeps left to right instead of jumping, and one --pm-lit variable recolours the whole ramp.
html: Use at least 8 characters 8+ Aa 0-9 #!

name: Inline Email Check
tags: email validation debounce spinner typo suggestion async
note: A debounced state machine drives idle, checking, error and valid, with a stroke-dashoffset tick draw and a one-tap domain-typo repair button.
html: We only email about your account.

name: Masked Phone Field
tags: mask phone tel format caret template monospace
note: A monospace ghost layer sits under the input — the typed part rendered transparent, the remaining template visible — so the mask never fights the caret, which is re-seated by counting digits.
html:
Mobile number
+1 (___) ___-____

We text a 6-digit code, never marketing

name: Currency Amount
tags: currency money format tween chips balance error
note: Thousands grouping is rebuilt on every keystroke with the caret re-seated by significant-character count, and the quick-add chips tween the amount with a cubic ease-out rAF loop.
